headline: Play comes
heroCopy: Bilbo Studios is an independent game studio from Bilbao, Spain. We create action, arcade, and multiplayer games built to be fun from the first run.
uninstallAlt: Uninstall Humanity: a blue armoured car charging through a horde of voxel robots
uninstallCopy: The machines have taken over. You're still driving. Tear through robot hordes, upgrade your ride, and fight for one more run.
piratesAlt: Pirates.io cover art with a pirate ship sailing across bright blue water
piratesCopy: Multiplayer naval combat across an open ocean of islands, treasure, and rival captains. Accepted on Poki and available as a preview.
pocketAlt: Pocket Goal World Cup players facing off across a football
pocketCopy: Fast table-football matches, quick tournaments, and instant local competition.
stellarAlt: Stellar Swarm spaceship flying through a meteor field
stellarCopy: Survive the swarm, evolve your ship, and turn every run into a new build.
title: Bilbo Studios — Indie Games from Bilbao
description: Discover Bilbo Studios, an independent game studio from Bilbao. Play Uninstall Humanity on Poki, Stellar Swarm, Pocket Goal: World Cup and Pirates.io.
studioCopy: Bilbo Studios is a one-person independent game studio based in Bilbao, Spain. Our games range from space survival and arcade football to multiplayer naval combat. Explore the games above or get in touch about a collaboration.
